# edgeos_system_syslog_host (Resource)

A remote syslog server (`system syslog host <host>`). EdgeOS sends the messages over UDP, to port 514 unless the host names another port.

Destroying the resource deletes the whole host node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_system_syslog_host" "siem" {
  host = "192.0.2.10"
  facilities = {
    all = "info"
  }
}

# A server on a non-standard port.
resource "edgeos_system_syslog_host" "archive" {
  host = "syslog.example.net:5140"
  facilities = {
    all      = "notice"
    authpriv = "info"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `facilities` (Map of String) Facilities to log and the lowest level logged for each (`facility <name> level <level>`), such as `{ all = "notice", protocols = "debug" }`. Facilities: `all`, `auth`, `authpriv`, `cron`, `daemon`, `kern`, `lpr`, `mail`, `mark`, `news`, `protocols`, `security`, `syslog`, `user`, `uucp`, `local0`, `local1`, `local2`, `local3`, `local4`, `local5`, `local6`, `local7`. Levels: `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `err`, `warning`, `notice`, `info`, `debug`. The resource owns the whole list: facilities that are not in the map are removed.
- `host` (String) Address or host name of the server, optionally with a port: `192.0.2.10`, `syslog.example.net:5140`, `2001:db8::10` or `[2001:db8::10]:5140`. Changing it creates a new host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The host, as in `host`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_system_syslog_host.siem
  id = "192.0.2.10"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <host>, with :port if the host has one
terraform import edgeos_system_syslog_host.siem '192.0.2.10'
```
